name: UNC Health Rex VolunTEEN Program
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Raleigh hospital one shift a week. You may greet visitors, round on patient rooms, help with discharges, restock supplies, deliver flowers, or help nurses with errands.
grades: 10th to 12th grade (finished 9th grade before the program starts)
who_can_apply: High school sophomores, juniors and seniors ages 14 to 18 who have finished their freshman year before the program starts.
duration: 8 weeks, June 21 to August 13, 2027. One 4-hour morning or afternoon shift a week, Monday to Friday. Only one absence allowed.
deadline_text: The 2027 Summer application is online only on March 11 and 12, 2027. Interviews March 22 to 25, orientation April 26 to 29, and you must volunteer the first week (June 21 to 25).
how_to_apply: Online application, plus two reference forms emailed by adults 21 or older who are not relatives (a school counselor, a teacher, or a supervisor). Interview if contacted.
notes: There is also an Academic Year Program (one day a week, 3 to 5 PM, September to May), but it is closed for 2026 to 2027. If accepted, you need a health screening (TB, whooping cough, chicken pox, MMR). Questions: volsvcs1@unchealth.unc.edu or 919-784-3165.
